name: Pittsburgh Summer B 2022
information:
This is a series competition with [Pittsburgh Summer A 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PittsburghSummerA2022). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Pittsburgh Summer A 2022, your registration for this competition will be rejected.
# Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue.
# All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue:
##### 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Sunday, July 31st is insufficient for entrance to the competition.
##### **OR** 
##### 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Wednesday, August 10th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. 
#### 
##### Along with a full vaccination or negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. Any proof sent electronically to the organizers and/or delegates prior to the competition will not be accepted. 
#####
